issue_request: FHIR-22106 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request asking to update AdverseEvent.supportingInfo.item so its definition clarifies relevant past history with a clinical-care penicillin-allergy example, a clinical-trials pre-existing bunion/rash example, and relevant documents such as clinical notes, staff lists, or material safety data sheets.
initial_application: Commit 9e8268a436e5a02c544cf149ef23f533f48978d1 explicitly applied GF#22106 to source/adverseevent/adverseevent-spreadsheet.xml. The 2021 source rework converted that spreadsheet content into source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml; a later typo cleanup corrected the inherited penicillin spelling.
additional_context: AdverseEvent is active in source/fhir.ini, including resource, normative-status, and abbreviation entries. Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-46599 intentionally changed AdverseEvent.supportingInfo from a BackboneElement with supportingInfo.item[x] to a repeating CodeableReference, preserving the clarified definition on the parent element. Community searches found no direct FHIR-22106 Zulip or Confluence discussion and no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current StructureDefinition definition for AdverseEvent.supportingInfo includes the FHIR-22106 examples with corrected spelling and compatible later wording that supporting information is not a contributing factor, preventive action, or mitigating action.
